apple_scab.symptoms: Velvety olive-green spots on leaves turning dark brown/black with distorted leaf curling; corky brown scabs on fruit surface.

organic_measures.name: Lime Sulfur / Liquid Copper Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray lime sulfur solution (2%) or copper hydroxide (2 g/L) during green tip and pink bud stages.
organic_measures.frequency: Every 7 to 10 days in wet spring weather

chemical_measures.name: Difenoconazole 25% EC or Captan 50% WP
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Do not apply lime sulfur within 2 weeks of oil sprays.

prevention_measures: Rake and shred or compost fallen apple leaves in autumn to eliminate overwintering ascocarps.
Prune trees to open canopy to sunlight and air.

apple_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange leaf spots with reddish borders on upper leaf side; tube-like cup structures (aecia) under leaves.

organic_measures.name: Sulfur / Potassium Bicarbonate Spray
organic_measures.method: Apply wettable sulfur (3 g/L) or potassium bicarbonate (4 g/L) from pink bud through petal fall.

prevention_measures: Remove alternate host red cedar/juniper trees within 500-1000 feet of orchard.
Plant rust-resistant apple cultivars (e.g., Enterprise, Liberty).
sources: Purdue University Extension Cedar Apple Rust

apple_healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green intact leaves, strong spur development, clean unblemished fruit.

organic_measures.name: Orchard Floor Management & Compost
organic_measures.method: Apply 20 kg composted manure per tree. Maintain mulch ring.

prevention_measures: Thin young fruit clusters for high fruit size and quality.
